title: MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE converge to Xingcheng-owned boundary
summary: Human-governor directive 2026-10-02: the canonical project_architecture_directory row for MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE still carries tool-era semantics - parent UNIT_ENGINE (the model/engine unit that hosts LOCAL_MODEL), dependencies listing local-model, and a bare 'training-owned job state' data authority. This contradicts architecture-tool-local-model and B81 SERVICE-BOUNDARY: Xingcheng is separate from local-model, which does not own, host or control it. The correction reparents the service under UNIT_ASSISTANT (BLOCK_XINGCHENG, the same unit as XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT and STAR_DIRECTORY), removes the false local-model dependency in favour of the actual authorities (governance codex|information layer|native compute core), restores the Xingcheng-exclusive data-authority wording its retired predecessor MODEL_TRAINING already carried, and declares the logical boundary as a Xingcheng-owned enclave whose source sits beneath registered XINGCHENG_PACKAGE_ROOT while runtime state and lifecycle remain under XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT. physical_root is unchanged because it records the true on-disk path; ownership is expressed through parent, dependencies, data_authority and the registered Xingcheng package root, matching the established nested-institution pattern already accepted for XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT itself. UNIT_ASSISTANT responsibilities gain MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE in the member list, and both a233_normalized_directory_entry projections are updated in the same revision so canonical and projection never diverge. Codex/registry-only change: no implementation or file is moved by this request.
